panels.title: Utilization
panels.description: Scheduler: percentage of time spent actively scheduling instead of sleeping between loops. Workers: Celery's own count of held slots over the budget the harness configured.

targets.expr: clamp_max(100 * sum by (perf_arm) (histogram_sum(rate(airflow_scheduler_scheduler_loop_duration_milliseconds[2m])) * on (exported_instance) group_left (perf_arm) target_info) / 1000, 100)
clamp_max(100 * perf_worker_slots_occupied / perf_worker_slot_budget, 100)

panels.title: CPU usage per process
panels.description: Per process tree the harness started; 100 is one busy core. Worker trees are summed.

targets.expr: perf_process_cpu_percent{role!~"worker_.*"}
sum(perf_process_cpu_percent{role=~"worker_.*"})

panels.title: Worker slots
panels.description: Slots held according to Celery, which includes the fork and supervisor overhead that the database's running state never sees.

targets.expr: perf_worker_slots_occupied
perf_worker_slot_budget

panels.title: Memory usage per process
panels.description: Summed over each process tree, so pages shared with forked children count more than once.

targets.expr: perf_process_rss_bytes{role!~"worker_.*"}
sum(perf_process_rss_bytes{role=~"worker_.*"})

panels.title: Hand-off rate (TIs/sec)
panels.description: Task instances per second crossing each state boundary. The first curve is the scheduler handing work to the executor, the second the workers starting it. Prometheus scrapes every 30 seconds, so a stage that fills and empties within one scrape leaves no rate behind; the cumulative panel below counts those too.

targets.expr: sum by (perf_arm) (histogram_count(rate(airflow_task_scheduled_duration_milliseconds[2m])) * on (exported_instance) group_left (perf_arm) target_info)
sum by (perf_arm) (histogram_count(rate(airflow_task_queued_duration_milliseconds[2m])) * on (exported_instance) group_left (perf_arm) target_info)

panels.title: Task timeline, mean seconds per phase
panels.description: Where a task instance spends its life. A scheduler change should move the first curve. The first two are means over the last five minutes. Each task process reports its own running time once and exits, so that curve is the mean over the task processes the collector still exposes, roughly the last five minutes as well.

targets.expr: sum by (perf_arm) (histogram_sum(rate(airflow_task_scheduled_duration_milliseconds[5m])) * on (exported_instance) group_left (perf_arm) target_info) / sum by (perf_arm) (histogram_count(rate(airflow_task_scheduled_duration_milliseconds[5m])) * on (exported_instance) group_left (perf_arm) target_info) / 1000

sum by (perf_arm) (histogram_sum(rate(airflow_task_queued_duration_milliseconds[5m])) * on (exported_instance) group_left (perf_arm) target_info) / sum by (perf_arm) (histogram_count(rate(airflow_task_queued_duration_milliseconds[5m])) * on (exported_instance) group_left (perf_arm) target_info) / 1000
targets.legendFormat: {{perf_arm}} queued: waiting for a worker slot

targets.expr: sum by (perf_arm) (histogram_sum(airflow_task_duration_milliseconds) * on (exported_instance) group_left (perf_arm) target_info) / sum by (perf_arm) (histogram_count(airflow_task_duration_milliseconds) * on (exported_instance) group_left (perf_arm) target_info) / 1000

sum by (perf_arm) (histogram_sum(rate(airflow_scheduler_scheduler_loop_duration_milliseconds[2m])) * on (exported_instance) group_left (perf_arm) target_info) / sum by (perf_arm) (histogram_count(rate(airflow_scheduler_scheduler_loop_duration_milliseconds[2m])) * on (exported_instance) group_left (perf_arm) target_info)
histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(airflow_scheduler_scheduler_loop_duration_milliseconds[2m])) * on (exported_instance) group_left (perf_arm) target_info
airflow_pool_scheduled_slots{pool_name="default_pool"} * on (exported_instance) group_left (perf_arm) target_info
airflow_pool_queued_slots{pool_name="default_pool"} * on (exported_instance) group_left (perf_arm) target_info
airflow_pool_running_slots{pool_name="default_pool"} * on (exported_instance) group_left (perf_arm) target_info
airflow_executor_queued_tasks * on (exported_instance) group_left (perf_arm) target_info
